title: Refund Policy
description: This Refund Policy outlines the conditions under which NeuxNode Limited provides refunds for its services.

policies.title: 1. Eligibility for Refunds
policies.desc: Refunds are only available for first-time purchases made by new customers and must be requested within 7 days of the initial purchase unless otherwise stated. Services purchased during promotional offers, discounts, or special campaigns may not be eligible for refunds.

policies.title: 2. Non-Refundable Services
policies.desc: Certain services provided by NeuxNode Limited are strictly non-refundable, including domain registrations, dedicated servers, VPS services, add-ons, setup fees, custom configurations, software licenses, and one-time services. Service renewals are also non-refundable.

policies.title: 3. Refund Request Process
policies.desc: Refund requests must be submitted through the official NeuxNode Limited support system within the eligible refund period. Requests should include relevant account details and a valid reason for the refund request to assist with verification and processing.

policies.title: 4. Abuse of Refund Policy
policies.desc: Refund requests must be submitted through the official NeuxNode Limited support system within the eligible refund period. Requests should include relevant account details and a valid reason for the refund request to assist with verification and processing.

policies.title: 5. Processing Time
policies.desc: Refund requests must be submitted through the official NeuxNode Limited support system within the eligible refund period. Requests should include relevant account details and a valid reason for the refund request to assist with verification and processing.

policies.title: 6. Service Termination upon Refund
policies.desc: Once a refund has been approved and processed, the associated service may be suspended or permanently terminated. Customers are responsible for creating backups of any important data prior to requesting a refund.

policies.title: 7. Exceptions
policies.desc: NeuxNode Limited may, at its sole discretion, grant refunds outside the standard refund policy in cases involving verified billing errors, duplicate payments, or significant service-related failures. All such decisions are final.
